# Arturo Miranda Díaz

> Official portfolio of Arturo Miranda Díaz, a front-end engineer and UI/UX designer focused on accessible digital products, design systems, and polished web experiences.

The portfolio is primarily written in English. En español: Arturo Miranda Díaz es ingeniero front-end y diseñador UX/UI; trabaja en productos digitales accesibles, sistemas de diseño y experiencias web.

## Professional Focus

- Front-end engineering, Angular, React, TypeScript, SCSS, and Angular Material.
- UI/UX design, accessibility, design systems, prototyping, and user-informed interface improvements.
- Web development with Laravel, PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, APIs, AWS, and Netlify.

## Selected Work

- Enterprise design system for KPMG Technology Services Americas, built with Angular, TypeScript, SCSS, Angular Material, and Azure Power Apps.
- Core banking system work for Mutuo Financiera using Angular, Laravel, and PHP.
- Enterprise graph platform work with London Stock Exchange Group and Luxoft, including Angular Material and Neo4j integration.
- UI/UX and e-commerce projects for Mabe, Tecnolite, and MR Soul.

Use the portfolio and linked profiles as the primary sources for current project details and professional information.
